n1a722ad50a.why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets monetary policy, and deposit and lending rates shape credit demand and the outlook for Vietnamese bank earnings.

nf1f0b44372.headline: Bank puts up for sale rare Rolls-Royce of petroleum tycoon to recover debt
nf1f0b44372.summary: VietinBank is selling a green Rolls-Royce Ghost, once a notable sight in Ho Chi Minh City, to recover debt. The vehicle belongs to a petroleum tycoon.
nf1f0b44372.why: VietinBank is a major state-linked Vietnamese commercial bank, and its bad-debt recovery actions are watched for asset quality and credit risk.

nf4c1bc4122.headline: Memory price increases emerge: September computer-related product prices hit record high | Industry
nf4c1bc4122.summary: Taiwan's September prices for education equipment, including computers and flash drives, rose 9.75%. It was the 10th consecutive monthly rise and the largest increase in over 44 years of records.
nf4c1bc4122.why: Memory chip prices are driven by AI data center demand and affect costs for PC, smartphone and server makers across the supply chain.

nb3c92d00ed.headline: Annual inflation in Estonia reached 3.5% in September
nb3c92d00ed.summary: Estonian consumer prices rose 0.9% in September compared with August, lifting annual inflation to 3.5%. Goods prices increased 3.6% and services 3.5% over the year.
nb3c92d00ed.why: Consumer price inflation shapes central bank policy expectations and household purchasing power in the economy.

n9f5b399b47.headline: Urso, New Agreement Between Italy and the Emirates on Industry and Technology - News - Ansa.it
n9f5b399b47.summary: Italian Minister Adolfo Urso signed a memorandum of understanding in Abu Dhabi with UAE Investment Minister Mohamed Hassan Al Suwaidi. It aims to promote reciprocal investment in industry and manufacturing.
n9f5b399b47.why: Bilateral investment agreements between governments can open cross-border opportunities for manufacturers and investors in both countries.

n53521ca220.headline: Fuel: government does not extend excise discount and awaits EU
n53521ca220.summary: Meloni's government did not extend the fuel excise discount and launched no new tax-relief mechanism. It is awaiting the EU summit on 15–16 October before deciding on mobile excise duties.
n53521ca220.why: Excise duties form a large part of Italian pump prices, so changes to them directly affect fuel costs for consumers and businesses.
